subject: Announce: Distance 3.5 Release 6 and D4 Beta 3

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Announce: Distance 3.5 Release 6 and D4 Beta 3
parts:
Hi distance-sampling list,

I have uploaded new releases of Distance 3.5 and Distance 4.0 beta to the
Distance web site http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

The new release of Distance 3.5, release 6, is almost identical to the previous
one, except that a minor bug with the install program has been fixed so that it
now installs under Windows 2000 (and hopefully XP). So, if you have release 5
already, there is no need to download the new version. There is a minor glitch
when installing the new release on Windows 2000 machines when Office 2000 is
already installed -- see the readme for details.

The new release of Distance 4.0, beta 3, fixes a number of problems, mostly
with the multiple covariates engine. See the "resolved problems" list on the
web site for details, or wait for a posting on the distance-sampling-d4beta
list. If you're interested in multiple covariates in the detection function
then you should download the new beta.

Both of these releases are identical to the ones we were using at the recent
distance sampling workshops, so if you were at the workshops, you already have
them on your CDs.

If you have any problems with either program, please consult the list of known
problems on the web page (under Distance Support). If you can't find an answer
there, please email me.

Cheers,

- Len Thomas
